mainEntity.name: What content should a pool contractor's website include for better optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pool contractor's website should include high-quality, informative content tailored to potential clients. Essential content includes detailed service pages for installation, repair, and maintenance, a portfolio showcasing completed projects with high-resolution images, and a clear 'About Us' section. Additionally, a blog with articles addressing common pool-related questions, design ideas, or local regulations can attract organic traffic. Testimonials and FAQs build trust. Ensure all content is geographically relevant and uses keywords potential customers would search for.
acceptedAnswer.description: Include detailed service pages, a project portfolio, an 'About Us' section, customer testimonials, and a blog with informative, keyword-rich content relevant to pool services and local areas.
